hero.title: Plan One Piece Treasure Cruise crews faster
hero.copy: OPTC Team Builder brings character search, manual crew planning, enemy mechanics, saved teams, screenshot imports, and local data tools into one offline-friendly web app.

account.signedOutCopy: Sign in to manage your profile and Google Drive backup from one place.
account.unavailableCopy: Google sign-in is not configured for this build.

highlights.offline: Browse and plan with local OPTC data
highlights.planning: Move from character search to crew ideas quickly
highlights.localData: Save teams, enemies, boxes, and settings in your browser

features.title: Every page has a planning job
features.copy: Use the site as a practical OPTC workspace: find units, compare abilities, check Rumble and captain coverage, build crews manually or automatically, save useful setups, and keep repeat planning tasks organized.

characters.title: Characters
characters.copy: Search and filter the catalog by name, type, class, ability data, favorites, and detailed character pages.

rumbleCharacters.title: Rumble Characters
rumbleCharacters.copy: Rank Pirate Rumble units by score, favorites, core filters, and custom stat focus before building teams.

autoBuilder.title: Auto Team Builder
autoBuilder.copy: Match enemy mechanics, ability requirements, classes, types, manual locks, and excluded units against candidate crews.

captainCoverage.title: Captain Coverage
captainCoverage.copy: Pick a Captain and see which characters that Captain Ability boosts, while the whole catalogue stays in the list and only your own filters narrow it.

autoRumble.title: Auto Team Rumble Builder
autoRumble.copy: Score rumble-capable units, compare synergy, and fill active and bench slots for Pirate Rumble teams.

savedRumbleTeams.title: Saved Rumble Teams
savedRumbleTeams.copy: Reload saved Rumble builds with their settings, two team variants, and opponent picks.

crewForge.title: Crew Forge
crewForge.copy: Import crew screenshots and match recognized slots back to editable OPTC character data.

savedTeams.title: Saved Teams
savedTeams.copy: Manage saved crews, inspect their slots and ships, reload older ideas, and export or import team data.

characterBoxes.title: Character Boxes
characterBoxes.copy: Organize owned units into boxes so team planning can focus on the characters you actually have.

savedEnemies.title: Saved Enemies
savedEnemies.copy: Store enemy presets and mechanics so Auto Team Builder can reuse quest requirements later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.copy: Change language, manage imports and exports, configure backups, Google Drive sync, and analytics consent.

workflow.title: From search to saved crew
workflow.copy: Start with a unit or quest requirement, shape the crew with manual or automatic tools, then keep the useful result for the next run.

steps.find: Find characters by name, ability, type, class, favorites, or enemy mechanics.
steps.plan: Build the crew manually, ask Auto Team Builder for candidates, or import an existing screenshot.
steps.save: Save teams, boxes, enemies, and settings locally, with import/export tools when you need to move data.

banner.title: Allow analytics cookies?
banner.copy: Enable optional Google Analytics cookies to help measure which screens are useful. The app keeps analytics off until you choose.
